purpose: Offline condition-driven EARLY; no production authority
development: 122 development contracts from prior September 26-29 cohort
calibration: 82 disjoint calibration contracts from that cohort; already used by prior research, not unseen
independence_scope: No October 6 rows or contract IDs found in prior corpus inventory; raw quote paths not previously retrieved by this investigation. Cannot certify all prior human exposure. Exact overlap checked before scoring.
entry_family: Aligned BTC and BRTI target gaps, 30s/120s momentum, 120s direction persistence and path efficiency, corroborating same-side quote movement, model confidence. Actual ASK/spread and empirical economics from condition-driven exits, never fair-as-exit or best future BID.
economic_profile: Fit one pooled condition-exit gross-gain distribution per side and ASK band (0-.5, .5-.8) using development contracts. Contract means prevent repeated entries inflating independent N. Require >=12 complete contracts, >=80% label coverage, >=6 each in calibration, positive conservative net lower bound and calibration mean; no cell pooling or threshold relaxation if unsupported.
lifecycle: Persistent/corroborated weakening -> WATCH; persistent price/underlying/settlement breakdown -> EXIT; no holding timer, no profit prerequisite; fresh reset and reconfirmation for re-entry. No automatic FINAL-confidence exit. No fixed profit target or trailing giveback rule.
cost_scenarios: One-contract quadratic taker fee ceil to cent on each leg, multiplier1; not verified account fees. Additional max(current spread,2c) reserve; 10s manual reaction primary, 5s/20s sensitivity. No fills claimed.
execution: First observed same-side quote at/after reaction delay, <=10s sampling tolerance. No unseen interpolation. Missing/stale/gapped quote paths censored; every proposal remains denominator.
validation: Freeze rules/profile before acceptance. Evaluate all contracts chronologically, actual condition-trigger times, historical proposal vs admitted coverage, false entries, missed positive condition-exit proposals, noise/recovery/churn, late entries, both sides and repeated episodes. No post-acceptance tuning.
readiness: Live profile always disabled. Native receipt identity, depth, fee schedule and execution measurements must be verified separately. If statistical or chronology gates fail return RESTRICT/FAIL with specific evidence.
